name: comp-459
title: Pagination With Ellipsis
description: A single-row pager showing Previous and Next around pages 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis before the end, and the current page lifted onto a rounded block.
use: Paging a list where people need to jump to a nearby numbered page.
avoid: When the total is huge: the row still shows about five slots and relies on ellipses.
a11y: Links have clear names and the ellipsis is described for screen readers; hover fills have no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One flat row on black holds an arrow-led Previous, the numbers 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis and Next with a right arrow. Page 3 sits in a small rounded grey square, and hovered labels gain a darker rounded fill.
behaves: Hovering any label lays a rounded block behind it; clicking a number moves the active square while the ellipsis stands for the skipped range. Nothing animates beyond the hover fills.
customise: Pass currentPage and totalPages, plus how many page slots to show; colours and the active box come from the shared pagination classes.
weight: light: A short row of page links; only hover fills and an active block.
demo: Page numbers 1 to 4 with an ellipsis, and the Previous and Next labels.
polishWhy: Clear page row with a tidy active block, but a standard numbered pager.
